page.layout: One printed page, left of the scan. Running head at top centre. Index lines in one column, with entries in the left margin (CAP.10., CAP.I., CAP.2., CAP.3.) and two bracketed diagrams in the column. Catchword at lower right. The strip at the far right is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

page.notes: The reading order of the diagram of Personas, seducentes and seductas is inferred from the brace. Its middle line "distinguendum inter" is taken as the lead box. The line "Spuriis leges durae sunt" is set on the brace level and may belong under Spurii. The "Mosaicis,in" spacing is copied as printed. The strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is left out.
